offer_summary: A 48-hour written dissection of one business decision with options and ranked recommendations.
audience: Solo operators and small teams deciding between two to four growth paths.
price_logic: Flat 249 USD prepay. No delivery starts until payment receipt exists in proof artifacts.
delivery_logic: Collect client brief, analyze options, and deliver a structured markdown memo within 48 hours.
proof_artifact_format: JSON file with payment receipt id, fulfillment timestamp, and delivery checksum.
ledger_format: JSONL append-only events with event_type, amount_usd, paid_signal, and verifier_outcome.
kill_condition: Kill after 14 days without any paid signal event in ledger.
clone_condition: Clone after 3 paid deliveries with at least 4.5 average rating and on-time proof.
success_criteria: At least 3 paid deliveries in 30 days with zero refund events.
